# Merged Vegetation native editor verification

Client date: 2026-11-20. Scope: merged `vegetation` gallery, historic kDEvad collection plus the unique personal lV0z8a images. Actual installed DS Gallery Editor v0.11, isolated scratch only. No repository, source, service, website, Git, or immutable-stage changes.

**Passed:** 29 Included originals resolved and all 29 individually selected image previews rendered. Adjacent reorder, explicit Save, actual folder reopen persistence, canonical order restoration and explicit Save passed. Exact image-only schema, all 29 unique names/order/case and all original hashes passed. The original 16 names remain an exact prefix and all 16 historic original hashes are unchanged. Stage has 28 valid filename-keyed caption strings and exactly one image with a null caption in provenance. No companion exists. All 69 actual stage files retain exact sizes/hashes.

**Failed:** none of the required native acceptance checks.

**Unverified by this lane:** live browser/caption rendering, publication, deployed delivery, global helper termination and yellow-frame disappearance. Root owns those gates.
